title: Hilton: India is set to become the world's third-largest hotel market

Hilton: India is set to become the world's third-largest hotel market
Alan Watts, President at Hilton Asia Pacific, says India's travel and tourism growth is being driven by resilient domestic demand rather than inbound tourism. He points to improving connectivity, faster transport links and rising household purchasing power as key catalysts for hotel expansion.
